Jhiram Ghati Naxal Attack Verdict Delivered After 13 Years

A special CBI court delivered its verdict in the Jhiram Ghati naxal attack case, 13 years after the incident. The attack, which occurred in Chhattisgarh, resulted in the deaths of senior Congress leaders. The National Investigation Agency (NIA) was involved in the case proceedings. The verdict was delivered by the court on the day the coverage was published.
